info.name: Ralsei - Scenario B Failed Trip Search Tests
info.description: Failed Scenario B cases only. Run repeatedly with Collection Runner or Newman for pressure/regression testing. No request mutates production data.

exec: const parseTime = (value) => { const time = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(time.getTime()) ? null : time; };
pm.test(`${id} returns a controlled HTTP status`, () => pm.expect(status).to.be.below(500));
pm.test(`${id} rejects the unsafe filter contract`, () => pm.expect(status).to.eql(400));
pm.test(`${id} preserves the paged response contract`, pageContract);
if (id === 'BK-TC-B02' && status === 200) pm.test('sold-out trips are excluded', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(Number(trip.availableSeats), `trip ${trip.tripId}`).to.be.above(0)));

if (id === 'BK-TC-B03' && status === 200) pm.test('null availableSeats has a valid totalSeats fallback', () => { const fallbackTrips = content.filter((trip) => trip.availableSeats === null && Number.isFinite(Number(trip.totalSeats)) && Number(trip.totalSeats) >= 0); pm.expect(fallbackTrips.length, 'seed at least one trip with null availableSeats and valid totalSeats').to.be.above(0); fallbackTrips.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(Number(trip.totalSeats), `trip ${trip.tripId} totalSeats`).to.be.at.least(0)); });

if (id === 'BK-TC-B06' && status === 200) pm.test('timestamps are valid ISO date-times', () => content.forEach((trip) => { pm.expect(parseTime(trip.departureTime), `trip ${trip.tripId} departureTime`).not.eql(null); pm.expect(parseTime(trip.arrivalTime), `trip ${trip.tripId} arrivalTime`).not.eql(null); }));

if (id === 'BK-TC-B07' && status === 200) pm.test('prices are finite and non-negative', () => content.forEach((trip) => { pm.expect(price(trip), `trip ${trip.tripId} seatPrice`).to.be.a('number').and.satisfy(Number.isFinite).and.at.least(0); }));
if (id === 'BK-TC-B19' && status === 200) pm.test('Under 300,000 is exclusive', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(price(trip), `trip ${trip.tripId}`).to.be.below(300000)));
if (id === 'BK-TC-B21' && status === 200) pm.test('Over 500,000 is exclusive and unbounded', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(price(trip), `trip ${trip.tripId}`).to.be.above(500000)));

if (id === 'BK-TC-B26' && status === 200) pm.test('latest requested layout owns every result', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(String(trip.coachTypeName).toLowerCase()).to.include('luxury')));

if (id === 'BK-TC-B34' && status === 200) pm.test('every selectable trip has a positive ID', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(trip.tripId, JSON.stringify(trip)).to.be.a('number').and.above(0)));

if (id === 'BK-TC-B37' && status === 200) pm.test('trips without active available seats are excluded', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(Number(trip.availableSeats), `trip ${trip.tripId}`).to.be.above(0)));

if (id === 'BK-TC-B40' && status === 200) pm.test('overlapping prices never duplicate a trip', () => { const ids = content.map((trip) => trip.tripId); pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(ids.length); });

if (id === 'BK-TC-B41' && status === 200) pm.test('route with extra hyphens is preserved', () => content.forEach((trip) => pm.expect(trip.routeName).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('hyphenatedRoute'))));
